scope: Complete 293-entry compilation reconciliation plus 166 additional records/leads. Independent primary verification remains incomplete. This is a conditional reference selection, not certification of original deposition at every included site.

principal.definition: Source-qualified climactic Mazama airborne fallout reference: 43 reported point values, 23 conditional lower bounds and one conditional upper bound. Compilation-supported values are not claimed independently primary-verified. Primary components, ranges and three Camp Creek section groups are documented in BOUND_REVIEW.md. Seven Yellowstone Lake locations use explicit 4–5 mm beds, paired cores counted once; see YELLOWSTONE.md. Nevada, Great Salt Lake, Goose Lake, Effingham Inlet and other lake/marine records are documented in FOLLOWUP_SEARCH.md. The final citation pass adds Dog Lake Oregon, White Pine Marsh, Connley Cave 2, Skull Creek and Lyman Lake; see LATE_SOURCE_REVIEW.md. One endpoint per physical reading; separate range-endpoint, weaker-transfer and omission refits. Known precursor totals, reworked totals and unquantified traces/proxies are omitted. No invented uncertainties, zeros or trace thresholds.

principal_limits.derivation: Conservative outward ceiling from author-estimated primary fallout: indexed 2-5 cm supports <=5 cm under decimal2.5 or range2–5 reading. Not the25 cm reworked total.
principal_limits.qualifications: Author estimate and phase containment conditional; scan typography unresolved; isolated omission and weaker10 cm upper tested.

target: Climactic Mazama primary airborne bulk deposit, including co-ignimbrite ash; exclude identified older precursor units and flow/reworked material. Legacy phase correlations remain conditional where primary logs are unavailable.
thickness_convention: Preserved bulk centimetres as a proxy for original local deposition. No universal decompaction correction. Component lower bounds assume in-place primary pumice without depositional thickening.
coordinate_datum: Published decimal or DMS positions used without an undocumented datum conversion; precision does not establish survey accuracy.

prior_release.scope: Current GitHub release preceding the Mazama source revision; the earlier local audit was performed on41b8f2f. Latest five-family results remain accessible at this immutable revision.
